77 def _inside(path, root):

90 def _frontmatter(text, field):
91     fm = re.match(r'^---\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n---', text)
92     if not fm:
93         return ''
94     m = re.search(r'^' + re.escape(field) + r':\s*(.*?)\s*$', fm[1], re.M)
95     return m[1].strip('"\'') if m else ''
96

98 def _section(text, heading):
99     m = re.search(r'^##[ \t]+' + re.escape(heading) + r'(?:[ \t]+[^\n]*)?\n([\s\S]*?)(?=^#{1,2}\s|\Z)',
100                   text, re.M | re.I)
101     return m[1].strip() if m else ''

104 def _icon(directory, text, skill_id):
105     edge = CODE_ROOT / 'foundry-gui/public/brand' / ('foundry-edge-' + skill_id + '.png')
106     if edge.is_file():
107         return '/brand/' + edge.name, None
108     icon = _frontmatter(text, 'icon')
109     candidates = [directory / icon] if icon else []
110     for folder in (directory / 'assets', directory / 'assets/icons'):
111         if folder.is_dir():
112             candidates.extend(sorted(folder.glob('icon.*')))
113     for path in candidates:
114         if _allowed(path) and path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in ICON_TYPES:
115             return '/foundry/icon?' + urlencode({'skill': skill_id}), str(path.resolve())
116     for key, name in ICON_NAMES:
117         if _key(skill_id) == key and (CODE_ROOT / 'vendor/brand' / name).is_file():
118             return '/vendor/brand/' + name, None
119     return None, None

122 def catalog():
123     foundry, skills_root, trio, steward = discovery_roots()
124     manifest = {str(Path(api._resolve_source(e.get('source'))).resolve()): e
125                 for e in api._load_manifest() if e.get('source')}
126     candidates = list(skills_root.glob('*/SKILL.md'))
127     candidates.extend(trio / name / 'SKILL.md' for name in ('crucible', 'foreman', 'researchPrime'))
128     candidates.append(steward / 'SKILL.md')
129     candidates.extend(Path(p) / 'SKILL.md' for p in manifest)
130     rows, seen = [], set()
131     for path in candidates:
132         directory = path.parent.resolve()
133         if str(directory) in seen or not path.is_file() or not _allowed(path):
134             continue
135         seen.add(str(directory))
136         text = _text(path)
137         if directory.name.lower() == 'templates' or _frontmatter(text, 'foundry').lower() == 'false':
138             continue
139         # agy-dispatch and Figure-Designer are explicitly excluded in the design;
140         # canonical frontmatter still needs the Foundry-owned follow-up.
141         if _key(directory.name) in ('agydispatch', 'figuredesigner'):
142             continue
143         entry = manifest.get(str(directory), {})
144         skill_id = 'ecgberht' if directory == steward.resolve() else _key(directory.name)
145         human = api._parse_human_md(_text(directory / 'HUMAN.md'))
146         parsed = api._parse_skill_md(text)
147         name = _frontmatter(text, 'name') or entry.get('name') or directory.name
148         if _key(name) == skill_id:
149             name = DISPLAY_NAMES.get(skill_id, name)
150         north = (_text(directory / 'NORTH-STAR.md').strip() or _section(text, 'North Star') or
151                  _text(directory / 'VISION.md').strip())
152         purpose = human['oneSentence'] or parsed['description'] or api._first_paragraph(parsed['body'])
153         icon, icon_path = _icon(directory, text, skill_id)
154         rows.append({'id': skill_id, 'name': name, 'purpose': purpose,
155                      'northStar': north, 'source': str(directory), 'ref': entry.get('ref'),
156                      'status': entry.get('status'), 'inFoundryMap': bool(entry),
157                      'icon': icon, 'iconPath': icon_path, 'role': None,
158                      'walkthrough': 'unfinished'})
159     profile = anchor_settings.steward_profile()
160     steward_row = next((r for r in rows if r['id'] == 'ecgberht'), None)
161     if steward_row:
162         rows.remove(steward_row)
163         for role, label, art, purpose in (
164             ('project', profile['seal_name'], profile['seal'],
165              'Keep one effort’s dialogue, decisions and delivery coherent.'),
166             ('portfolio', profile['high_seat_name'], profile['high_seat'],
167              'Seat and coordinate initiatives across projects.'),
168             ('starchart', profile['campaign_name'], profile['campaign_icon'],
169              'Explore goals and foresight, then hand approved work to the portfolio steward.')):
170             rows.append({**steward_row, 'id': 'steward-' + role,
171                          'name': profile['label'] + '-' + label, 'role': role,
172                          'purpose': purpose, 'icon': '/brand/foundry-edge-ecgberhtportfolio.png'
173                          if role == 'portfolio' and profile['key'] == 'ecgberht' else '/vendor/brand/' + art, 'iconPath': None})
174     rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['name'].casefold())
175     return {'skills': rows, 'persona': profile['label'],
176             'walkthroughOrder': ['researchprime', 'gandalf', 'steward-project',
177                                  'steward-portfolio', 'steward-starchart'],
178             'contentRoot': str(content_root()), 'northStar': api.load_north_star()}

185 def _load_artifact(skill, names):
186     directory = Path(skill['source'])
187     role = skill.get('role')
188     searches = [(content_root() / skill['id'], names), (directory, names)]
189     if role:
190         searches = [(content_root() / ROLE_CONTENT[skill['id']], names),
191                     (content_root() / skill['id'], names),
192                     (directory, tuple(name.replace('.json', '.' + role + '.json') for name in names)),
193                     (directory / 'knowledge' / role, names)]
194     for base, file_names in searches:
195         for name in file_names:
196             path = base / name
197             if not path.is_file() or not _allowed(path):
198                 continue
199             try:
200                 data = json.loads(_text(path))
201                 if not isinstance(data, (dict, list)):
202                     raise ValueError('expected an object or array')
203                 return data, path, None
204             except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
205                 return None, path, 'Unreadable content: ' + str(exc)
206     return None, None, None

209 def _path(raw, directory, artifact_dir=None):
210     if not raw or not isinstance(raw, str) or '\x00' in raw:
211         return None
212     raw = raw.replace('\\', '/')
213     path = Path(raw)
214     if '..' in path.parts:
215         return None
216     candidates = [path] if path.is_absolute() else [directory / path]
217     if not path.is_absolute():
218         if artifact_dir:
219             candidates.append(artifact_dir / path)
220         candidates.extend([Path(api.FOUNDRY_ROOT) / path, discovery_roots()[2] / path])
221     return next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if p.is_file() and _allowed(p)
222                  and p.suffix.lower() in TEXT_TYPES and not any(
223                      part.startswith('.') for part in p.relative_to(p.anchor).parts
224                      if part not in ('.agents', '.claude', '.codex'))), None)

231 def _trusted_origin(raw, skill):
232     """A role may cite these exact originals; no user-home/root expansion."""
233     if skill['id'] not in ROLE_CONTENT or not isinstance(raw, str):
234         return None
235     candidate = Path(raw.replace('\\', '/'))
236     if not candidate.is_absolute() or '..' in candidate.parts:
237         return None
238     approved = [(root / rel, root) for root in
239                 (CODE_ROOT, Path(api.FOUNDRY_ROOT).parent / 'Anchor')
240                 for rel in ANCHOR_PROVENANCE]
241     global_dir = Path.home() / '.claude'
242     approved.append((global_dir / 'AGENTS.md', global_dir))
243     for exact, root in approved:
244         if (candidate == exact and _inside(candidate, root) and candidate.is_file()
245                 and candidate.resolve() == root.resolve() / exact.relative_to(root)):
246             return candidate.resolve()
247     return None

250 def _declared_source(source, skill, base):
251     """Resolve only this inventory entry, with frozen examples hash-bound."""
252     provenance = {k: source.get(k) for k in
253                   ('origin', 'freshness', 'captured_at', 'captured_from', 'applicability', 'sha256')}
254     if source.get('freshness') == 'frozen-example':
255         snapshot = source.get('snapshot')
256         digest = source.get('sha256')
257         if (not isinstance(snapshot, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{64}', str(digest or ''))
258                 or not all(source.get(k) for k in ('captured_at', 'captured_from', 'applicability'))):
259             return None, provenance, 'Historical source lacks its capture identity or qualification'
260         raw = Path(snapshot.replace('\\', '/'))
261         target = base / raw
262         if (raw.is_absolute() or '..' in raw.parts or any(p.startswith('.') for p in raw.parts)
263                 or not _inside(target, base / 'sources') or not _allowed(target)
264                 or not target.is_file() or target.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_TYPES):
265             return None, provenance, 'Historical snapshot missing or outside its bundle sources'
266         if hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
267             return None, provenance, 'Historical snapshot hash mismatch'
268         return target.resolve(), provenance, None
269     if source.get('freshness') not in (None, 'current-source'):
270         return None, provenance, 'Unsupported source freshness'
271     target = (_path(source.get('origin'), Path(skill['source']), base)
272               or _trusted_origin(source.get('origin'), skill))
273     return target, provenance, None if target else 'Missing or outside the declared source inventory'

276 def _anchor_link(anchor, skill, artifact_dir, resources, *, declared_path=None, provenance=None):
277     if isinstance(anchor, str):
278         anchor = {'path': anchor}
279     if not isinstance(anchor, dict):
280         return None
281     if anchor.get('type') in ('no-code', 'no-instruction'):
282         return {'label': anchor.get('type'), 'note': anchor.get('reason') or 'Not implemented on this path.'}
283     path = declared_path or _path(anchor.get('path') or anchor.get('file'), Path(skill['source']), artifact_dir)
284     if not path:
285         return {'label': 'Source unavailable', 'problem': 'Missing or outside the declared source roots'}
286     at = str(anchor.get('symbol') or anchor.get('heading') or anchor.get('anchor') or anchor.get('line') or '')
287     content = _text(path)
288     problem = None
289     if at.isdigit() and not 1 <= int(at) <= len(content.splitlines()):
290         problem = 'Source changed: line no longer present'
291     elif at and not at.isdigit() and at not in content:
292         problem = 'Source changed: anchor no longer present'
293     expected = anchor.get('sha256') or anchor.get('hash')
294     if expected and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
295         problem = 'Source changed since this map was checked'
296     resource = _resource(skill, path, 'tools', path.name, anchor=at)
297     if provenance:
298         resource['provenance'] = provenance
299     if not any(r['id'] == resource['id'] for r in resources):
300         resources.append(resource)
301     return {'label': path.name + (' · ' + at if at else ''), 'href': resource['href'],
302             'resourceId': resource['id'], 'problem': problem}

305 def _resource(skill, path, category, title, anchor='', resource_id=None):
306     return {'id': resource_id or hashlib.sha256((str(path) + '#' + anchor).encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
307             'title': title, 'category': category, 'path': str(path), 'anchor': anchor,
308             'href': source_url(skill['id'], path, anchor), 'frequency': 'Use not recorded'}

319 def _library_target(raw, base, project_id):
320     if not project_id or not isinstance(raw, str):
321         return None
322     rel = Path(raw.replace('\\', '/'))
323     target = base / rel
324     if (rel.is_absolute() or '..' in rel.parts or any(p.startswith('.') for p in rel.parts)
325             or not _inside(target, base / 'resources') or not _inside(target, Path(api.FOUNDRY_ROOT))
326             or not target.is_file() or target.suffix.lower() != '.html'):
327         return None
328     relative = target.resolve().relative_to(Path(api.FOUNDRY_ROOT).resolve()).as_posix()
329     return '/artifact/' + quote(str(project_id), safe='') + '/' + quote(relative, safe='/')

332 def _frequency(record, skill, artifact_dir):
333     """Only counts backed by distinct existing run records get a use label."""
334     evidence = record.get('useEvidence') or record.get('usage_evidence') or []
335     if not isinstance(evidence, list):
336         return 'Use not recorded'
337     paths = {_path(p.get('path') if isinstance(p, dict) else p,
338                    Path(skill['source']), artifact_dir) for p in evidence}
339     paths.discard(None)
340     run_ids = set()
341     for path in paths:
342         if path.suffix != '.json' or not any(p in ('journal', 'runs') for p in path.parts):
343             continue
344         try:
345             data = json.loads(_text(path))
346             # A journal file existing is not proof that this resource was used.
347             if (isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('run_id') and
348                     record.get('id') in data.get('resource_ids', [])):
349                 run_ids.add(str(data['run_id']))
350         except (ValueError, TypeError):
351             pass
352     return f'{len(run_ids)} recorded ' + ('use' if len(run_ids) == 1 else 'uses') if run_ids else 'Use not recorded'

355 def _combined_display(skill, resources):
356     """Foundry-owned foundry-skill-display/v1 handoff; canonical sources stay live.
357 
358     Anchors use the controlled reader. Historical examples use only their exact
359     immutable snapshots; current sources retain visible freshness checks.
360     """
361     data, path, error = _load_artifact(skill, ('maps.json',))
362     if data is None:
363         return None, [error] if error else []
364     if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get('schema') != 'foundry-skill-display/v1' or data.get('skill_id') != skill['id']:
365         return None, ['Unsupported or different-skill maps.json handoff']
366     for field in ('sources', 'anchors', 'resources'):
367         if not isinstance(data.get(field), list):
368             return None, [field + ' must be an array in maps.json']
369     for field, child in (('knowledge', 'nodes'), ('process', 'steps'), ('process', 'edges')):
370         if not isinstance(data.get(field), dict) or not isinstance(data[field].get(child), list):
371             return None, [field + '.' + child + ' must be an array in maps.json']
372     issues, links = [], {}
373     sources = {s.get('id'): s for s in data.get('sources', []) if isinstance(s, dict)}
374     declared = {sid: _declared_source(source, skill, path.parent) for sid, source in sources.items()}
375     for anchor in data.get('anchors', []):
376         if not isinstance(anchor, dict):
377             issues.append('Invalid source anchor')
378             continue
379         source = sources.get(anchor.get('source_id'), {})
380         target, provenance, source_error = declared.get(anchor.get('source_id'),
381                                                        (None, {}, 'Undeclared source'))
382         spec = {'path': source.get('origin'), 'line': anchor.get('start'), 'sha256': source.get('sha256')}
383         link = (_anchor_link(spec, skill, path.parent, resources, declared_path=target, provenance=provenance)
384                 if target else {'label': 'Source unavailable', 'problem': source_error})
385         if link and link.get('href'):
386             start, end = anchor.get('start'), anchor.get('end')
387             if isinstance(start, int) and isinstance(end, int) and 1 <= start <= end <= len(_text(target).splitlines()):
388                 excerpt = '\n'.join(_text(target).splitlines()[start - 1:end])
389                 if anchor.get('sha256') and hashlib.sha256(excerpt.encode()).hexdigest() != anchor['sha256']:
390                     link['problem'] = 'Source changed: anchored excerpt differs'
391             else:
392                 link['problem'] = 'Invalid source range'
393         if not link:
394             link = {'label': 'Source unavailable', 'problem': 'Missing original source'}
395         if link.get('problem'):
396             issues.append(link['problem'] + ' · ' + str(anchor.get('source_id')) + ' / ' + str(anchor.get('id')))
397         links[anchor.get('id')] = link
398     categories = {'Reusable material': 'material', 'References': 'references', 'Other skills': 'skills', 'Tools': 'tools'}
399     project_id = _review_project_id() if any(r.get('target') for r in data['resources'] if isinstance(r, dict)) else None
400     for row in data.get('resources', []):
401         if not isinstance(row, dict):
402             issues.append('Invalid Library resource')
403             continue
404         link = links.get(row.get('anchor_id'), {})
405         if not link.get('href'):
406             issues.append('Library target missing: ' + str(row.get('id')))
407             continue
408         backing = next((r for r in resources if r['id'] == link.get('resourceId')), {})
409         resources.append({**backing, 'id': row.get('id'), 'title': row.get('title'),
410                           'category': categories.get(row.get('category'), 'material'),
411                           'description': row.get('summary', ''), 'problem': link.get('problem'),
412                           'href': _library_target(row.get('target'), path.parent, project_id) or backing['href'],
413                           'sourceHref': backing['href'],
414                           'frequency': _frequency(row, skill, path.parent), 'library': True})
415     flow = data.get('process') if isinstance(data.get('process'), dict) else {}
416     steps = []
417     for row in flow.get('steps', []):
418         if not isinstance(row, dict):
419             issues.append('Invalid process step')
420             continue
421         aa = [links[a] for a in row.get('anchors', []) if a in links]
422         steps.append({**row, 'description': row.get('summary'), 'anchorLinks': aa,
423                       'codeLink': aa[0] if row.get('code_status') == 'anchored' and aa else
424                           {'label': 'instructions-only', 'note': 'Session work; no code on this path.'},
425                       'instructionLink': aa[-1] if row.get('instruction_status') == 'anchored' and aa else
426                           {'label': 'no-separate-instruction', 'note': 'See the program source.'}})
427         if not aa:
428             issues.append('No process sources: ' + str(row.get('id')))
429     knowledge = data.get('knowledge') if isinstance(data.get('knowledge'), dict) else {}
430     nodes = [{**n, 'name': n.get('title'), 'parent': n.get('parent_id')}
431              for n in knowledge.get('nodes', []) if isinstance(n, dict)]
432     disagreements = [{**d, 'sourceLinks': [links[a] for a in d.get('anchors', []) if a in links]}
433                      for d in flow.get('disagreements', []) if isinstance(d, dict)]
434     return {'source': str(path), 'qualification': data.get('refinement') or 'Walkthrough awaiting human review.',
435             'steps': steps, 'edges': [{**e, 'from': e.get('source'), 'to': e.get('target'),
436                                       'sourceLink': links.get(e.get('anchor_id'))}
437                                      for e in flow.get('edges', []) if isinstance(e, dict)],
438             'exits': flow.get('terminals', []),
439             'disagreements': disagreements, 'nodes': nodes, 'issues': issues,
440             'observedExamples': [{**e, 'sourceLinks': [links[a] for a in e.get('anchors', []) if a in links]}
441                                  for e in data.get('observed_examples', []) if isinstance(e, dict)],
442             'usageAudit': data.get('usage_audit')}, issues

449     directory = Path(skill['source'])
450     resources = []
451     for name in ('SKILL.md', 'HUMAN.md', 'NORTH-STAR.md', 'VISION.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'LESSONS.md'):
452         path = _path(name, directory)
453         if path:
454             resources.append(_resource(skill, path, 'material', name))
455     journals = sorted((directory / 'journal').glob('*.md'), reverse=True)
456     for path in journals:
457         if _path(str(path), directory):
458             resources.append(_resource(skill, path.resolve(), 'references', path.stem))
459     # Commands and links already declared by the skill open their actual files.
460     instructions = _text(directory / 'SKILL.md')
461     pattern = r'(?:[A-Za-z]:[/\\][^\s`"<>|)]+|(?:[\w.-]+[/\\])+[\w.-]+)\.(?:md|mjs|js|py|json|ts)'
462     for raw in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(pattern, instructions)):
463         path = _path(raw.rstrip('.,;'), directory)
464         if path and not any(r['path'] == str(path) for r in resources):
465             resources.append(_resource(skill, path, 'tools', path.name))
466     library, library_path, library_error = _load_artifact(skill, ('library.json', 'LIBRARY.json'))
467     artifact_dir = library_path.parent if library_path else directory
468     entries = library if isinstance(library, list) else (library or {}).get('resources', [])
469     issues = [library_error] if library_error else []
470     if not isinstance(entries, list):
471         entries = []
472         issues.append('Library resources must be an array')
473     for entry in entries:
474         if not isinstance(entry, dict):
475             issues.append('Invalid Library resource')
476             continue
477         category = entry.get('category') or entry.get('kind') or 'material'
478         title = entry.get('title') or entry.get('name') or entry.get('id') or 'Resource'
479         anchor = entry.get('anchor')
480         target = entry.get('path') or entry.get('file') or (anchor.get('path') if isinstance(anchor, dict) else None)
481         path = _path(target, directory, artifact_dir)
482         url = entry.get('url') or entry.get('href')
483         at = (anchor.get('symbol') or anchor.get('heading') or '') if isinstance(anchor, dict) else (anchor or '')
484         if path:
485             r = _resource(skill, path, category, title, str(at), entry.get('id'))
486         elif url and urlsplit(url).scheme in ('https', 'http') and urlsplit(url).netloc:
487             r = {'id': entry.get('id') or url, 'title': title, 'category': category,
488                  'href': url, 'external': True}
489         elif entry.get('skill') and find_skill(_key(entry['skill'])):
490             r = {'id': entry.get('id') or entry['skill'], 'title': title, 'category': 'skills',
491                  'href': '/foundry?' + urlencode({'skill': _key(entry['skill'])})}
492         else:
493             issues.append('Library target missing: ' + str(title))
494             continue
495         r['frequency'] = _frequency(entry, skill, artifact_dir)
496         r['library'] = True
497         r['description'] = entry.get('description') or entry.get('purpose') or ''
498         resources = [old for old in resources if old['id'] != r['id']]
499         resources.append(r)
500     # Composition is displayed from the existing map, never guessed from names.
501     manifest = next((e for e in api._load_manifest() if e.get('ref') == skill.get('ref')), {})
502     for edge in manifest.get('edges', []):
503         other = next((r for r in catalog()['skills'] if r.get('ref') == edge.get('to')), None)
504         if other:
505             resources.append({'id': 'skill-' + other['id'], 'title': other['name'], 'category': 'skills',
506                               'href': '/foundry?' + urlencode({'skill': other['id']}),
507                               'description': edge.get('type'), 'frequency': 'Use not recorded'})
508     combined, combined_issues = _combined_display(skill, resources)
509     issues.extend(combined_issues)
510     flow = _process_map(skill, resources, combined)
511     knowledge = _knowledge_map(skill, resources, combined)
512     human = _text(directory / 'HUMAN.md')
513     return {'skill': skill, 'resources': resources, 'libraryIssues': issues,
514             'libraryResources': [r for r in resources if r.get('library')] or
515                 [r for r in resources if r.get('category') != 'references'],
516             'librarySource': combined['source'] if combined else str(library_path) if library_path else None,
517             'processMap': flow, 'knowledgeMap': knowledge,
518             'howItWorks': _section(human, 'How it works') or 'Walkthrough not completed yet. Read the instructions below.',
519             'timeline': api._journal_events(str(directory)),
520             'capabilities': api._extract_section_details(api._parse_skill_md(instructions)['body']),
521             'journalCount': len(journals)}
522

524 def _process_map(skill, resources, combined=None):
525     if combined:
526         issues = list(combined['issues'])
527         issues.extend(_edge_issues(combined['steps'], combined['edges']))
528         return {**combined, 'status': 'needs checking' if issues else 'source-anchored draft', 'issues': issues}
529     data, path, error = _load_artifact(skill, ('process-map.json', 'FLOW.json'))
530     if not isinstance(data, dict):
531         return {'status': 'unfinished', 'issues': [error] if error else [], 'steps': [], 'exits': []}
532     steps = data.get('steps') or []
533     if not isinstance(steps, list):
534         return {'status': 'needs checking', 'issues': ['Process steps must be an array'], 'steps': [], 'exits': []}
535     if not steps:
536         for stage in data.get('stages', []):
537             for row in stage.get('steps', stage.get('rows', [])):
538                 steps.extend(row if isinstance(row, list) else row.get('boxes', [row]))
539     projected, issues = [], []
540     for index, step in enumerate(steps):
541         if not isinstance(step, dict):
542             issues.append('Invalid process step')
543             continue
544         anchors = step.get('anchors') if isinstance(step.get('anchors'), dict) else {}
545         code = _anchor_link(step.get('code') or anchors.get('code'), skill, path.parent, resources)
546         ins = _anchor_link(step.get('instructions') or step.get('instruction') or anchors.get('instructions'), skill, path.parent, resources)
547         if not code or not ins:
548             issues.append('Missing code/instruction declaration: ' + str(step.get('id', index)))
549         issues.extend(a['problem'] for a in (code, ins) if a and a.get('problem'))
550         projected.append({**step, 'id': step.get('id') or str(index),
551                           'title': step.get('title') or step.get('name') or step.get('t'),
552                           'kind': step.get('kind') or step.get('k') or 'program',
553                           'description': step.get('description') or step.get('summary') or step.get('d'),
554                           'codeLink': code, 'instructionLink': ins})
555     issues.extend(_edge_issues(projected, data.get('edges', [])))
556     return {'status': 'source-anchored draft' if not issues else 'needs checking',
557             'source': str(path), 'qualification': data.get('qualification') or 'Walkthrough awaiting human review.',
558             'steps': projected, 'edges': data.get('edges', []), 'exits': data.get('exits', []),
559             'swarm': data.get('swarm'), 'issues': issues,
560             'disagreements': data.get('disagreements', []), 'deliverable': data.get('deliverable') or data.get('outputs')}
561 
562 
563 def _edge_issues(steps, edges):
564     ids = [s.get('id') for s in steps]
565     issues = ['Duplicate process step IDs'] if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) else []
566     if not isinstance(edges, list):
567         return issues + ['Process edges must be an array']
568     for edge in edges:
569         if not isinstance(edge, dict) or edge.get('from') not in ids or edge.get('to') not in ids:
570             issues.append('Process edge has a missing step')
571     return issues
572 
573 
574 def _knowledge_map(skill, resources, combined=None):
575     data, path, error = ({'nodes': combined['nodes']}, Path(combined['source']), None) if combined else _load_artifact(skill, ('knowledge-map.json', 'knowledge/graph.json', 'graph.json'))
576     if not isinstance(data, dict):
577         return {'status': 'unfinished', 'issues': [error] if error else [], 'nodes': [],
578                 'qualification': 'Not drawn yet. No learned geometry or use frequency is available.'}
579     nodes = data.get('nodes') or []
580     if not isinstance(nodes, list):
581         return {'status': 'needs checking', 'issues': ['Knowledge nodes must be an array'], 'nodes': []}
582     projected, issues = [], []
583     by_id = {str(n.get('id')): n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, dict)}
584     if len(by_id) != len(nodes):
585         issues.append('Duplicate or invalid knowledge node IDs')
586     for node in nodes:
587         if not isinstance(node, dict):
588             issues.append('Invalid knowledge node')
589             continue
590         node_id = str(node.get('id'))
591         parents = node.get('parent_ids') or ([node['parent']] if node.get('parent') else [])
592         if not isinstance(parents, list):
593             parents = []
594             issues.append('Parent IDs must be an array: ' + node_id)
595         depth, seen, parent = 0, {node_id}, (parents[0] if parents else None)
596         if len(parents) > 1:
597             issues.append('Multiple parents: ' + node_id)
598         while parent:
599             if str(parent) in seen or str(parent) not in by_id:
600                 issues.append('Broken or cyclic hierarchy: ' + node_id)
601                 break
602             seen.add(str(parent))
603             depth += 1
604             ancestor = by_id[str(parent)]
605             pp = ancestor.get('parent_ids') or ([ancestor['parent']] if ancestor.get('parent') else [])
606             parent = pp[0] if pp else None
607         if node.get('ring') is not None and node['ring'] != depth:
608             issues.append('Ring disagrees with tree depth: ' + node_id)
609         resource_id = node.get('resourceId') or node.get('resource_id') or node.get('resource')
610         resource = next((r for r in resources if str(r['id']) == str(resource_id)), None)
611         link = None if resource else _anchor_link(node.get('anchor'), skill, path.parent, resources)
612         if link:
613             resource = next((r for r in resources if r['id'] == link.get('resourceId')), None)
614             if link.get('problem'):
615                 issues.append(link['problem'])
616         if not resource:
617             issues.append('No real Library target: ' + node_id)
618         elif resource.get('problem'):
619             issues.append(resource['problem'])
620         projected.append({**node, 'id': node_id, 'name': node.get('name') or node.get('title') or node_id,
621                           'parent': parents[0] if parents else None, 'depth': depth,
622                           'resourceId': resource['id'] if resource else None,
623                           'href': resource.get('href') if resource else None})
624     return {'status': 'seeded draft' if not issues else 'needs checking', 'source': str(path),
625             'qualification': 'Seeded declared hierarchy — not calibrated or learned geometry. Size does not represent use frequency.',
626             'nodes': projected, 'issues': issues}
627

629 def source_page(skill_id, requested, anchor=''):
630     """Exact allowlist of this skill's discovered Library/anchor resources."""
631     detail = skill_detail(skill_id)
632     if not detail:
633         return None
634     try:
635         raw = Path(requested.replace('\\', '/'))
636         if '..' in raw.parts:
637             return None
638         requested_path = raw.resolve()
639     except (OSError, ValueError):
640         return None
641     targets = [r for r in detail['resources'] if r.get('path') and Path(r['path']).resolve() == requested_path]
642     if not targets or not (_path(requested, Path(detail['skill']['source']))
643                            or _trusted_origin(requested, detail['skill'])):
644         return None
645     provenance = next((r['provenance'] for r in targets if r.get('provenance')), {})
646     try:
647         payload = requested_path.read_bytes()
648         text = payload.decode('utf-8-sig')
649     except (OSError, UnicodeError):
650         return None
651     if (provenance.get('freshness') == 'frozen-example' and
652             hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != provenance.get('sha256')):
653         return None
654     lines = text.splitlines()
655     hit = (int(anchor) if str(anchor).isdigit() else
656            next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if anchor and anchor in line), 0))
657     esc = html.escape
658     provenance_html = ''
659     if provenance.get('freshness'):
660         provenance_html = ('<aside class="source-provenance" data-source-freshness="%s">'
661                            '<strong>%s</strong><p>Captured: %s</p><p class="path">Captured from: %s</p>'
662                            '<p>%s</p><p class="path">Capture SHA-256: %s</p></aside>') % tuple(esc(str(v or '')) for v in (
663                                provenance['freshness'],
664                                'Frozen historical example — not current state' if provenance['freshness'] == 'frozen-example'
665                                else 'Current source — on-disk bytes do not prove live activation',
666                                provenance.get('captured_at'), provenance.get('captured_from') or provenance.get('origin'),
667                                provenance.get('applicability'), provenance.get('sha256')))
668         if (provenance.get('freshness') == 'current-source' and provenance.get('sha256') and
669                 hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != provenance['sha256']):
670             provenance_html += '<p>Source changed since capture; the current file is shown below.</p>'
671     rendered = '\n'.join('<span id="L%d" class="%s"><a href="#L%d">%d</a> %s</span>' %
672                          (i, 'hit' if i == hit else '', i, i, esc(line))
673                          for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1))
674     return '''<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8">
675 <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>%s — Foundry source</title>
676 <style>body{margin:0;background:#0f1117;color:#e2e4e9;font:15px/1.5 system-ui}header{padding:18px;border-bottom:1px solid #2e3340}a{color:#9ec0ff}pre{padding:18px;overflow:auto}pre span{display:block;min-height:1.5em}pre a{display:inline-block;width:4em;color:#8b8f9a}.hit{background:#3a2e17;outline:1px solid #e0a84a}h1{font-size:20px;margin:8px 0}.path{overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#8b8f9a}</style>
677 <header><a href="/foundry?skill=%s">← %s</a><h1>%s</h1><div class="path">%s</div><p>Read-only source%s</p></header>
678 %s<pre>%s</pre>%s</html>''' % (esc(requested_path.name), esc(skill_id), esc(detail['skill']['name']),
679                            esc(requested_path.name), esc(str(requested_path)),
680                            ' · anchor not found' if anchor and not hit else '', provenance_html, rendered,
681                            '<script>document.getElementById("L%d")?.scrollIntoView({block:"center"})</script>' % hit if hit else '')
